_about: The Straight Path (levels 13-32): a road of trials from the bank toward the Utmost Throne, its dark halls of evil and temptation and its halls of light. The Great Ifrit, a demon of smokeless fire, waits in Spiritual Danger where the road turns toward the dark.

1590.room_desc: A brass lamp lies here, a thread of smoke curling from its spout.
1590.description: A battered brass lamp with a long spout, warm to the touch. A thin flame of smokeless fire burns at its lip and never goes out.

1591.room_desc: A scimitar of rippling flame lies here.
1591.description: A curved blade that seems forged from flame without smoke, rippling with heat. It does not burn the hand that holds it.

1590.name: ifrit demon great smoke
1590.long_desc: The Great Ifrit, a towering demon of smokeless fire, coils in the shadows of the hall.
1590.description: A giant shape of living flame without smoke, horned and broad as a doorway, its eyes two coals. It waits where the road turns toward the dark, and whispers to every traveller that the other way is easier.

phases.message: The Great Ifrit swells to fill the hall, and its flame turns white!

abilities.name: Smokeless Flame
abilities.telegraph: The Great Ifrit draws in a breath, and the air shimmers with heat!

abilities.name: Scimitar of Fire
abilities.telegraph: The Great Ifrit raises a blade of flame!

abilities.name: Whispered Doubt
abilities.telegraph: The Great Ifrit begins to whisper, and your resolve wavers!

bosses.why: the Great Ifrit in Spiritual Danger, where the road of trials turns toward the halls of earthly evil

mechanics.shout: The shadows in the corners gather and thicken around the Great Ifrit...
mechanics.why: the hall darkens as he weakens
